name: Question 7
problem: Find all of the solutions to ${x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}-2x+20=0$ given that $x=3-\text{i}$ is a solution.
worked_solution:
First, we let $f(x)={x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}-2x+20.$ 

Since $f(x)$ has real coefficients and ${x}_{1}=3-\text{i}$ is a root of $f(x),$ the complex conjugate 

$$
\overset{―}{{x}_{1}}=\overset{―}{3-\text{i}}=3+\text{i}
$$

must also be a root of $f(x).$

Now, according to the factor theorem, 
$(x-(3-\text{i}))(x-(3+\text{i}))$
is a factor of $f(x).$ Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}(x-(3-\text{i}))(x-(3+\text{i})) & = \\ {x}^{2}-(3-\text{i}+(3+\text{i)})x+(3-\text{i})(3+\text{i}) & = \\ {x}^{2}-6x+({3}^{2}-(\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ {x}^{2}-6x+10 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we find the quotient when $f(x)$ is divided by ${x}^{2}-6x+10$ using polynomial division.

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,\,\,\,x+2 \\  & {x}^{2}-6x+10\,\,\enclose{longdiv}{\,{x}^{3}-4{x}^{2}-2x+20} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{{x}^{3}-6{x}^{2}+10x}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,2{x}^{2}-12x+20 \\  & \,\,\,\,\,{2{x}^{2}-12x+20}_{―} \\  & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,0\end{aligned}
$$

     

Thus, $f(x)=({x}^{2}-6x+10)(x+2).$ 

To find the remaining root, we set the linear factor equal to zero and solve for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}x+2=0\,⟹\,x=-2.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the roots are $x=-2,3\pm \text{i}.$

Question 7
?

Find all of the solutions to x3−4x2−2x+20=0 given that x=3−i is a solution.

a
x=−2,0,3−i
b
x=2,3±i
c
x=±2,3−i
d
x=−2,3±i
e
x=0,3−i,1+3i
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

First, we let f(x)=x3−4x2−2x+20.

Since f(x) has real coefficients and x1=3−i is a root of f(x), the complex conjugate

x1―=3−i―=3+i must also be a root of f(x).

Now, according to the factor theorem, (x−(3−i))(x−(3+i)) is a factor of f(x). Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

(x−(3−i))(x−(3+i))=x2−(3−i+(3+i))x+(3−i)(3+i)=x2−6x+(32−(i)2)=x2−6x+10.

Next, we find the quotient when f(x) is divided by x2−6x+10 using polynomial division.

x2−6x+10x+2x2−6x+10x3−4x2−22x+20x2−6x+10x3−6x2+10x―x2−6x+102x3+2x2−12x+20x2−6x+102x3+2x2−12x+20―x2−6x+102x3−9x2+20x+0

Thus, f(x)=(x2−6x+10)(x+2).

To find the remaining root, we set the linear factor equal to zero and solve for x:

x+2=0⟹x=−2.

Therefore, the roots are x=−2,3±i.
